# Vektorsynapse — Comprehensive Studio Knowledge Base

> Full-Stack Software Studio building production-grade web, mobile and desktop applications. Single-point technical accountability from architecture to deployment.

## Entity Overview
- **Studio Name**: Vektorsynapse
- **Entity Type**: Software Engineering Studio & Technical Consulting
- **Official Website**: https://vektorsynapse.netlify.app
- **Official Contact**: contact.vektorsynapse@gmail.com
- **Official GitHub**: https://github.com/vektorsynapse
- **Target Regions**: Global (Ireland, United States, United Kingdom, India)
- **Primary Languages**: English
- **Pricing Model**: Fixed-price milestone contracts with transparent scopes and zero hidden fees

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. High-Performance Business Websites
- **Core Stacks**: Next.js 14/15 (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Engineering Standards**: 90+ Google PageSpeed Insights, 0.00 Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
- **Architecture**: Route-level code-splitting, modern responsive image formats (AVIF/WebP), accessible ARIA standards, semantic HTML5

### 2. Scalable Web Applications
- **Core Stacks**: Next.js, React, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma
- **Engineering Standards**: Type-safe REST and GraphQL APIs, JWT/session authentication, RBAC authorization, automated schema validation (Zod)

### 3. Cross-Platform Mobile Applications
- **Core Stacks**: Flutter, Dart, Firebase Authentication, Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), SQLite
- **Engineering Standards**: Clean architecture, Material Design 3, real-time sync, offline caching, push notifications

### 4. Offline Desktop Software
- **Core Stacks**: Electron, SQLite, TypeScript, local hardware driver interfaces
- **Engineering Standards**: Offline-first architecture, local data encryption, automated local backups, fast POS billing workflows

### 5. API Architecture & Cloud Integrations
- **Core Stacks**: Node.js, NestJS, Express, Serverless Functions, Netlify, Vercel
- **Engineering Standards**: Resilient error boundaries, structured JSON logging, email automation (Resend), transactional webhooks

## Shipped Client Projects & Case Studies (Verified Facts)

### 1. Comfort Floors & Bathrooms
- **Client**: Comfort Floors & Bathrooms (via Tech Kshatriyas)
- **Location**: Ireland
- **Period**: Nov 2024 – Mar 2025
- **Platform**: Business website
- **Live URL**: https://comfortfloors.ie/
- **Key Metrics**: 92/100 Google PageSpeed Insights score, 0.00 CLS
- **Technologies**: Next.js 14, TypeScript, React.js, Tailwind CSS
- **Summary**: Modern, lightning-fast digital storefront serving Irish homeowners and commercial contractors with instant mobile load times on cellular connections.

### 2. JNTUA College of Engineering Portal
- **Client**: JNTUA College of Engineering
- **Location**: Pulivendula, India
- **Platform**: Institutional university portal
- **Live URL**: https://jntuacep.ac.in/
- **Key Metrics**: Thousands of active students, faculty, and administrative staff served with 100% uptime
- **Technologies**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL
- **Summary**: Ongoing core web architectural maintenance, frontend navigation fixes, academic circular publication, and database tuning.

### 3. SuperCabs
- **Client**: Zyrone Energy (In-house product)
- **Location**: Gujarat, India
- **Period**: Mar 2025 – Jul 2025
- **Platform**: Mobile app (Flutter)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/vektorsynapse/SuperCabs
- **Technologies**: Flutter, Dart, Firebase Auth, FCM, Material Design, RESTful APIs
- **Summary**: Cross-platform mobile cab rental and mobility app frontend featuring 3-step OTP onboarding, driver document verification, and real-time push notification alerts.

### 4. Medcare
- **Client**: Medcare
- **Location**: India
- **Platform**: Offline desktop billing software
- **Key Metrics**: Sub-second invoice printing, 100% local operation with zero cloud dependencies
- **Technologies**: Electron, SQLite, Node.js
- **Summary**: Offline-first commercial billing and inventory software built for retail counter reliability without internet connectivity.

### 5. Sayed Wedding Invitation
- **Client**: Sayed family Nikah celebration
- **Platform**: Interactive 3D web experience
- **Live URL**: https://sayed-wedding-invitation.netlify.app/
- **Key Metrics**: 61 automated unit tests, 1,902 characters zero-JS fallback
- **Technologies**: TypeScript, Vite, Three.js, GSAP, Lenis, HarfBuzz
- **Summary**: Bilingual (English/Telugu) 3D interactive digital invitation with pre-shaped calligraphy and individual guest RSVP access.

### 6. Agnikula Kshatriyas IT Solutions
- **Client**: Agnikula Kshatriyas IT Solutions
- **Platform**: Corporate website
- **Live URL**: https://agnikulakshatriyasitsolutions.com/
- **Technologies**: NestJS, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs
- **Summary**: Corporate identity platform showcasing engineering competencies and client acquisition channels.

## Working Principles & Operating Model
- **Single Point of Technical Accountability**: Direct communication with the engineer building your product — no account managers or telephone game.
- **Strict Code Ownership**: 100% client intellectual property ownership upon final milestone delivery with full documentation and deployment runbooks.
- **Fixed-Price Milestones**: Transparent milestone scopes with clear acceptance criteria and zero unexpected charges.
- **International Availability**: Overlap with IST, GMT, and EST working hours for seamless collaboration.
